summary: Quiet residential kerb under trees, homes 18 m away, steep grade.

drivers.seclusion: Homes 18 m, 22 m and 27 m away at the start; a wooded block lies behind the kerb.
drivers.access_and_room: Sealed street with no signs; a van is parked near the start, so stopping is possible.
drivers.traffic: Quiet residential street, little through traffic.
drivers.convention: Odd cars park along the kerb but no clear convention.

flags: Steep: about 8% over 16 m, up to 12% overall
Houses 10 m away from 21 m onwards
sun_shade: Heavily shaded by tree canopy to the north and north-east.

best_section.where: Julie Street north kerb at the uphill end, beside the wooded block
